statements.status_notes: GO-2026-5932 covers the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package, which upstream declares unmaintained and unsafe by design with no fixed version (all versions affected). govulncheck binary-mode symbol analysis of the shipped source-controller binary confirms vulnerable x/crypto/openpgp symbols are present and reachable (110 symbols, e.g. armor.Decode/armor.Encode), so this is not a false positive and cannot be excluded by a dependency bump. No patched x/crypto release exists and upstream fluxcd/source-controller has not migrated away from x/crypto/openpgp. Under investigation pending an upstream migration to a maintained OpenPGP implementation.

No patched x/crypto release exists and upstream fluxcd/source-controller has not migrated away from x/crypto/openpgp. Under investigation pending an upstream migration to a maintained OpenPGP implementation.

CVE-2026-47680 is fixed in fluxcd/source-controller 1.8.5. The 1.6.x and 1.7.x image lines track their upstream minor release lines, and no fixed 1.6.x or 1.7.x patch release is available. Moving these variants to 1.8.5 would cross minor lines and change the published version track, so the older minor lines remain under investigation while awaiting upstream patch releases.
